pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Role-based access control library for Proxmox VE. Provides user/group/realm management, permission checking, TFA (TOTP/FIDO2/recovery keys), LDAP/AD integration, OpenID Connect (Proxmox::RS::OIDC via libproxmox-rs-perl), and API endpoints under /access/.
Note: Runtime depends on libpve-cluster-perl (pmxcfs) to read /etc/pve/user.cfg. On single-node systems without pmxcfs, /etc/pve/ must be a plain directory seeded with minimal config files (see docs/packages/pve-access-control.md).
Shell completions and man page generation are skipped; pve-doc-generator is not yet ported.
